verdict.rationale: Speech is Cheap documents long-form transcription of files up to 24 hours or 2 GiB, and its API job-creation docs confirm direct uploads of up to 2 GiB. Both the maximum duration and file size are therefore documented for single jobs. Missing for 10: the 24-hour cap appears only on the marketing homepage rather than the API reference, limits for URL-submitted files are not stated explicitly, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-hour jobs succeeding.
